postgresql.note: Each mission created an isolated collection. The database retained unrelated prior benchmark collections, so these are conservative shared-relation local timings rather than a pristine-database microbenchmark.

semantic_assertions: schema-proven string and boolean predicates execute exactly in SQL
group counts use the canonical mdbase-rs reducer result shape
malformed projected scalar values trigger canonical fail-closed evaluation
exact body output decrypts only the selected page
typed wall-time budget remains 15000 ms per operation
index_policy: B-no-GIN; mandatory identity/path/cursor indexes only; no general JSONB GIN or automatic field indexes
limitations: Single observations are correctness and scale evidence, not latency distributions.
The fixture duplicates projection rows directly to isolate executor scaling; it is not an import, write-pressure, or ciphertext-throughput measurement.
The selected predicate matches two rows, so the mission does not establish a high-cardinality result-transfer entitlement.
